## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the cylindrical can with bright colors and the can with gold logo design together, then set both in the rectangular plasticbox with locking clips.

Task description: Pick up both the brightly colored cylindrical can on the left and the can with a gold logo on the right, and put them in the rectangular plastic box with a latch at the front center.

Success criteria: Both target cans have been placed in the plastic box, each horizontally close to either of the box’s two target placement locations; both grippers are open and have released the cans.

## Execution tips

- Grip the upper-middle cylindrical can wall, avoiding the rolled top rim and narrowed bottom. Open slightly wider than its diameter and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing, increasing pad contact and leaving lower clearance for box insertion.
- As both arms bring the cans toward the box, adjust their relative positions where there is clearance above the opening, leaving space between the can bodies and both sets of fingers to avoid squeezing them against each other.
- When crossing the box rim, keep both the can bottom and fingertips above the rim and latch. Leave clearance between the fingers and box wall during descent to avoid catching the latch or shifting the plastic box.
- Keep the can upright during placement and support its bottom on the box bottom before releasing. Leave finger-opening and withdrawal space to avoid toppling it or hitting walls and the other can.
